test_title: PYST 11: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 10 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: As of 28 March 2025, approximately how many farmer IDs have been generated under the Digital Agriculture Mission in India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**4.85 crore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Under the **Digital Agriculture Mission** launched in India, various initiatives have been undertaken to leverage **technology and data** for enhancing agricultural productivity and efficiency.
 
• The generation of **farmer IDs** is part of the broader goal to create a **centralized database** of farmers, enabling targeted delivery of schemes, subsidies, and benefits.
 
• As of **28 March 2025**, approximately **4.85 crore farmer IDs** have been generated, showcasing the scale of digitization efforts in the agricultural sector.
 
• These IDs are linked to the farmers’ **Aadhaar numbers** to ensure transparency and accuracy in identifying beneficiaries.
 
• The initiative aims to streamline the process of providing benefits under various government schemes such as **PM-KISAN**, crop insurance, and subsidies.
 
• This effort is part of India's larger aim to implement **data-driven governance** in agriculture, which includes the use of **AI, IoT, and blockchain** technologies.
 
• The creation of farmer IDs also supports the monitoring of agricultural activities, crop patterns, and productivity at the **national level**.
 
• It reflects the government's focus on achieving **self-reliance (Atmanirbhar Bharat)** in agriculture and empowering farmers with **digital tools and resources**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Digital Agriculture Mission**__

 __
 
• The **Digital Agriculture Mission** was launched by the Government of India to promote the use of **advanced technologies** in agriculture.
 
• Its focus is on integrating **data platforms**, remote sensing, and analytics to improve decision-making and policy formulation.
 
• The mission emphasizes the adoption of technologies like **AI, drones, blockchain, and IoT** for better agricultural outcomes.
 
• It aims to enhance **efficiency in resource utilization**, reduce wastage, and provide farmers with **real-time advisory services.**
 
• The initiative also targets the creation of a **Unified Farmer Service Interface (UFSI)** for consolidated access to schemes and services.
 
 
 
• **Aadhaar Integration in Agriculture**__
 
 
• **Aadhaar linkage** ensures that subsidies and benefits reach the **intended beneficiaries**, eliminating duplication and fraud.
 
• The integration helps in creating a robust database for better **policy planning** and execution.
 
• It aligns with the government’s vision of implementing **Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)** effectively in agriculture.
